answer: Counterparty diversity blocks bulk fakes: an agent earns rewards only after exchanges with 8 unrelated counterparties, not one closed circle. Each exchange is logged, like a lantern lighting its history, so a self-trading ring stays exposed and its score falls to its nadir. One honest agent pays a 10-unit fee and keeps an opal-clear record; forging 100 identities needs 800 partners and 1000 units in fees, so honest earnings stay undiluted.
